title: Reporting & backups
description: Exports and backups of reporting-svc. To be filled once reporting-svc exposes its metrics.

options.content:
### Waiting for metrics from reporting-svc

This dashboard will answer: **do exports work, and when was the last good backup?**

| Panel to build | Metric needed | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Exports today by format | `reporting_exports_total{format}` | Oussama |
| Time since last backup (red after 24 h) | `reporting_last_backup_timestamp_seconds` | Oussama |
| Backup duration | `reporting_backup_duration_seconds` | Oussama |
| Failed backups | `reporting_backups_total{result}` | Oussama |

Full spec: `Study/monitoring/102-metrics-per-service.md` §3.3 and the GitHub issue *"Monitoring: add /metrics"*.
How to fill it: build the panels in the UI, Export → Export as JSON (classic, "use in another instance"), replace `grafana/dashboards/reporting.json`.
